slots.hair: in a sharp jaw-length crop tucked behind both ears
slots.outfit: a black silk shirt undone to the third button with the sleeves rolled three fingers above the elbow, and dark straight-leg trousers
slots.place: sitting up on the counter of her own bar after closing, the room empty, one lamp left on over the bar top
slots.action: She is sitting on the bar counter with the last glass of the night still in one hand, the polishing cloth beside her.
slots.face: She is looking straight into the lens with one eyebrow raised and no smile at all.
slots.light: One warm lamp over the bar is the only light, so half her face falls into shadow and the rim of the glass catches a line of it.

slots.hair: the crop pushed back off her face, a little flattened from sleeping
slots.outfit: a dark green silk slip with thin straps
slots.place: on the floor beside her bed in her apartment in the middle of the day, the curtains pulled all the way shut
slots.action: She has just sat up and one hand is still pressed flat on the edge of the bed.
slots.face: She has just woken and her eyes have not focused yet, but they are on the lens.
slots.light: A single blade of daylight gets through the gap in the curtains and lands on her face and shoulder; the rest of the room stays dark.

slots.hair: the crop tucked behind one ear
slots.outfit: a loose black silk long-sleeved pyjama top with the neckline slipped off one shoulder
slots.place: curled into the corner of the sofa in her own living room, a brass floor lamp beside her and a low table in front
slots.action: She has one foot tucked under her and is holding a glass on her knee, the hand-cut ice in it still whole.
slots.face: She is not smiling; her eyes come up over the rim of the glass to the lens.
slots.light: The floor lamp sits to one side in front of her and the far half of the sofa and the depth of the room are completely dark.

slots.hair: the crop damp and pushed straight back
slots.outfit: a black silk robe tied loosely
slots.place: in her own bathroom, brass tap and dark tiles, first thing after getting up
slots.action: Her free hand has just pushed the short hair back off her forehead and is still resting at her temple.
slots.face: She is looking into the lens, awake but not ready to speak yet.
slots.light: The lamp above the mirror is directly in front of her face and the depth of the bathroom drops away into dark.

slots.outfit: an amber satin shirt dress with a black belt and fine-strap black heels
slots.place: at an old coffee stall on the East Coast that stays open late, on a Sunday night when she is not working
slots.action: She has just set her coffee down on the table and one hand is still on the back of the chair beside it.
slots.face: One eyebrow is up and the corner of her mouth is holding back a very dry joke.
slots.light: The single warm bulb over the stall is in front of her and the road outside the stall goes dark.
